applicability.unknown_policy: explicit unknown_incomplete states permit inference with disclosure; partial/conflicting required inputs yield needs_clarification and stop later questions; false gate does not occur (applies to all registration encounters)

context_output_resource_limits.note: cpt_cells counts LLM-estimated percentage cells (roots 4+3+3+3=13 plus child 108x22=2376). No silent truncation: if complete CPT output cannot fit, reject admission or fail clearly.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

engine_configuration.inference: deterministic exact inference only; fail on impossible evidence or resource exhaustion, never approximate or soften
engine_configuration.note: engine is pinned per run; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without calling the provider

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations.

output_catalog_binding.note: No reviewed drug catalog release exists (no content/ddi catalog; S18 pending). States below are Table 6 oral ingredients in Table 6 order with PROVISIONAL identifiers for review. They must be replaced by released catalog concept IDs before activation.
output_catalog_binding.provisional_id_scheme: ingredient-<lowercase-ingredient-name> (proposed only, not a released concept ID)

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unknown/not_assessed/missing -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure); partial or conflicting values -> needs_clarification (blocks)
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval for difficulty/response; registration encounter for clinical_status
patient_mappings.typed_transform: no_prior_trial_assessed iff clinical_status==first_time AND difficulty absent-or-not-recorded AND no prior antipsychotic in medication history; prior_course_without_difficulty iff established course without important difficulty; prior_difficulty iff difficulty present (inadequate response or intolerance); else unknown_incomplete. Never infer absence from missing documentation.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unassessed/missing -> unknown_incomplete (permits inference with disclosure); conflicting values -> needs_clarification (blocks)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: identified_vulnerability iff a reviewed comorbidity/age anchor is recorded present (anchors proposed: age>=65 pending owner, cardiac/seizure/diabetes-relevant flags pending owner); no_identified_vulnerability iff anchors explicitly assessed absent; else unknown_incomplete. Age is reported age 18-99, never an inferred birth date.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent -> unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected; conflicting values -> needs_clarification
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff an unresolved objection or practical barrier is recorded; absent_assessed iff preferences discussed and none recorded; else unknown_incomplete. Not a judgment of capacity.

patient_mappings.typed_transform: possible_modifier iff any concomitant medication presence, reported smoking change, or organ-function flag is recorded that may alter exposure (CYP relevance judged by physician, not by DDI verdict); no_identified_modifier iff medication list reconciled without such entries AND smoking absent AND organ flags absent; else unknown_incomplete. No dose, unit, route, frequency, or active/stopped values are read: excluded by FR-14 and by design, not by hidden fields.

review.assumptions: see review.json unresolved_assumptions; reference tables synthetic; catalog binding provisional; both-usage rationale proposed
